items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: And also, I think I played under him in Indianapolis, if I remember correctly. Well, to me, as far as the conductors that I've played under, of course, to my estimation, the best conductor there is, is Ernest Ansarmette... I mean, from the recordings I've heard, I like his interpretations.

ctx.x: Who's the best that you've worked under?

Well, I think the best conductor I worked under was Arthur Wierczynski. I mean, he was a real fine, fine musician. And where was this? Well, this was in New Orleans. He was guest conductor. And also, I think I played under him in Indianapolis, if I remember correctly. Well, to me, as far as the conductors that I've played under, of course, to my estimation, the best conductor there is, is Ernest Ansarmette, the conductor of the Orchester de la Suisse Romande. I mean, from the recordings I've heard, I like his…
Did you work with any great guest soloist?
